reach_notInitialized: Reach module not initialized, call reach.init() first
reach_providerRequired: No provider specified, set provider field in message or template
reach_dndBlocked: Message discarded by Do Not Disturb period
reach_dndPersistenceRequired: DND delay requires an initialized database and a ready queue table
reach_dndEnqueueFailed: The message could not be reliably queued; try again later
reach_sendRecordSaveFailed: Failed to persist the reach send record
reach_invalidStoredInteger: Send record {field} is not a safe non-negative integer
reach_claimLost: The valid delivery lease was lost
reach_unknownResolutionFailed: Unknown delivery was not found or has already been resolved
reach_queueInputInvalid: Invalid queue receipt or manual resolution parameters
reach_deliveryUnknown: The external delivery outcome is unknown; manual review is required and automatic redelivery has stopped
reach_config_dndTimeInvalid: Invalid time format, must be HH:mm (24-hour)
reach_config_providersRequired: At least one provider is required
reach_queueRetryInvalid: maxRetryDelayMs must be at least retryDelayMs
reach_deadRequeueFailed: Dead message changed or does not exist; reload its state before restoring
reach_productionProviderRequired: Production requires a delivery provider; console is available only in development or explicit test mode
reach_sensitivePolicyRequired: Credential notifications require a database receipt, stable idempotency key and expiry
reach_sensitiveDeliveryUnconfirmed: Credential delivery is unconfirmed and will not be retried automatically. Check the receipt or request new credentials.
